Definition: from G2470 and G5590; of similar spirit:--likeminded.
BiblicalUsage: Likeminded is the word Paul uses for Timothy, and he says he has no one else like him. In Philippians 2:20 he writes, I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe likemindedness is the rarest gift in ministry: a man who cares for the flock the way I would, without being asked.
